features.title: Onboarding and first work
features.description: Instance setup, company wizard, first agent and task.

capabilities.label: Instance
capabilities.description: choose local instance configuration and start the server.

capabilities.label: Company
capabilities.description: create a company with its identity and initial agent.

capabilities.label: Adapter
capabilities.description: choose an available harness, model, account, and execution environment.

capabilities.label: First task
capabilities.description: leave setup with a task whose execution or missing prerequisite is visible.

capabilities.label: Resume
capabilities.description: return to an incomplete wizard without losing saved state.

features.title: Login, invitations, and access
features.description: Sessions, bootstrap, membership, roles, and CLI authorization.

capabilities.label: Login
capabilities.description: sign in or claim the board in the configured deployment mode.

capabilities.label: Invitations
capabilities.description: join through a valid invite and handle expired or already-used links.

capabilities.label: Membership
capabilities.description: review join requests and manage company/instance membership and permissions.

capabilities.label: Resources
capabilities.description: respect company and resource boundaries on deep links and mutations.

capabilities.label: Cli auth
capabilities.description: authorize a CLI session and revoke or replace credentials.

features.title: Companies and portability
features.description: Company switching/settings, archival, package import/export.

capabilities.label: Selection
capabilities.description: create/select a company and keep navigation in its scope.

capabilities.label: Identity
capabilities.description: update company identity and configured settings.

capabilities.label: Archive
capabilities.description: archive and restore through the available controls without confusing archival with deletion.

capabilities.label: Portability
capabilities.description: preview a company package and inspect imported agents, projects, skills, and conflicts.

features.title: Task creation and lifecycle
features.description: Creation, assignment, lists, properties, comments, and completion.

capabilities.label: Create
capabilities.description: capture a title/request with the intended agent, project, and attachments.

capabilities.label: Organize
capabilities.description: filter, sort, group, and navigate tasks without losing the selected context.

capabilities.label: Properties
capabilities.description: change status, priority, assignee, project, and relationships where authorized.

capabilities.label: Discussion
capabilities.description: persist comments, references, and files on the task.

capabilities.label: Completion
capabilities.description: distinguish backlog, active work, review, blocked, done, and cancelled outcomes.

features.title: Delegation, dependencies, and signoff
features.description: Child work, prerequisites, reviewers, and task-tree controls.

capabilities.label: Delegation
capabilities.description: inspect parent/child tasks and the original request behind delegated work.

capabilities.label: Dependencies
capabilities.description: show blocking tasks and wake eligible work when prerequisites resolve.

capabilities.label: Signoff
capabilities.description: apply the configured implementation/review completion policy.

capabilities.label: Tree control
capabilities.description: pause or resume a task tree without bypassing its gates.

features.title: Inbox, decisions, and search
features.description: Personal triage, decision queues, unread/blocked views, and search.

capabilities.label: Views
capabilities.description: use Mine, Recent, Unread, Blocked, and broader task views.

capabilities.label: Triage
capabilities.description: read or archive attention items without pretending the underlying task is complete.

capabilities.label: Decisions
capabilities.description: open the source of a decision and act in the right context.

capabilities.label: Search
capabilities.description: query company work and follow a result to its original record.

features.title: Agent conversations and project handoff
features.description: Persistent conversations, discovery, handoff, and gated board chat.

capabilities.label: Discovery
capabilities.description: find an agent and reopen an accessible recent conversation.

capabilities.label: History
capabilities.description: send messages, inspect replies/files, and return to the same conversation.

capabilities.label: Handoff
capabilities.description: create or identify a project/task from chat and follow the resulting work.

capabilities.label: Conference room
capabilities.description: use the separately gated board chat without assuming parity with agent chat.

features.title: Questions and approvals
features.description: Question/plan responses, formal approvals, and app-tool review.

capabilities.label: Questions
capabilities.description: single-choice, multiple-choice, custom, and free-text answers; paged forms retain answers until submission and show validation failures.

capabilities.label: Dismiss and reopen
capabilities.description: unanswered questions remain in the feed after dismissal or a newer message; reopening restores the form without inventing an answer.

capabilities.label: Confirmations
capabilities.description: accept, decline, or request changes; stale, expired, resolved, and withdrawn requests cannot be acted on again.

capabilities.label: Plan review
capabilities.description: inspect the requested plan revision before accepting or asking for changes. An ordinary planning task can proceed to execution; Agent Chat hands work to linked tasks and remains a conversation.

capabilities.label: Audience
capabilities.description: the current actor, company, named audience, and review policy govern resolution. A visible request is not necessarily actionable by that viewer.

capabilities.label: Governance
capabilities.description: pending/history views, approve/reject, revision request, and resubmission for formal board approvals.

capabilities.label: Tool review
capabilities.description: approve once, always allow the displayed scope, or decline; decision status and provider execution outcome remain distinct.

capabilities.label: Continuation
capabilities.description: one recorded response leads to the eligible waiting run or continuation; repeated clicks, reloads, and competing tabs do not repeat work.

features.title: Steering and queued messages
features.description: Follow-ups, queue edits, interruption, and pause/resume.

capabilities.label: Queue
capabilities.description: a busy task saves follow-ups and shows their order and wait reason.

capabilities.label: Edit order discard
capabilities.description: edit full Markdown, reorder, and discard eligible saved messages; ownership, revision conflicts, and already-dispatched states matter.

capabilities.label: Steer
capabilities.description: explicit user action sends a queued message into a compatible active run; unavailable capabilities and provider rejection remain visible.

capabilities.label: Interrupt
capabilities.description: stop the current execution and carry accepted follow-ups into the eligible continuation without delivering them twice.

capabilities.label: Stop and pause
capabilities.description: distinguish stop-in-flight, confirmed stop, task/ancestor pause, agent pause, and budget hold. Resume must respect the actual gate.

capabilities.label: Drafts
capabilities.description: switching tasks, reloading, and uncertain submission retain the correct task's draft and attachment receipts.

capabilities.label: Approval queue
capabilities.description: answered questions and accepted approvals have durable delivery distinct from editable ordinary comments.

features.title: Documents, attachments, and work products
features.description: Versioned documents, annotations, files, outputs, and artifact library.

capabilities.label: Documents
capabilities.description: edit versioned task documents and inspect or restore revisions.

capabilities.label: Annotations
capabilities.description: attach feedback to document content and inspect resolution state.

capabilities.label: Attachments
capabilities.description: upload, preview, and download allowed files with company access checks.

capabilities.label: Work products
capabilities.description: link deliverables to their source task, resource, and review context.

capabilities.label: Library
capabilities.description: search, filter, group, and open artifact stacks.

features.title: Hiring, configuration, and organization
features.description: Agent identity, instructions, reporting lines, lifecycle, and built-ins.

capabilities.label: Hire
capabilities.description: choose identity, adapter, model, and required account settings; edit reporting relationships through the agent configuration afterward.

capabilities.label: Instructions
capabilities.description: edit agent configuration and instruction files with durable revisions.

capabilities.label: Organization
capabilities.description: inspect and change reporting relationships through supported controls.

capabilities.label: Lifecycle
capabilities.description: pause/resume or retire an agent while preserving history.

capabilities.label: Built in
capabilities.description: configure required agents without treating them as ordinary removable hires.

features.title: Runs, harnesses, and model accounts
features.description: Adapter/model setup, account validation, transcripts, and run history.

capabilities.label: Availability
capabilities.description: discover installed adapters and available models/accounts.

capabilities.label: Validation
capabilities.description: test an adapter in the selected execution environment and surface authentication failures.

capabilities.label: Runs
capabilities.description: inspect run status, events, output, costs, and the source task.

capabilities.label: Session
capabilities.description: preserve or reset execution context through supported lifecycle actions.

features.title: Skills and Skill Studio
features.description: Discovery, sources, authoring, revisions, tests, and agent policies.

capabilities.label: Discovery
capabilities.description: browse installed/discover views and import a skill or source.

capabilities.label: Authoring
capabilities.description: create/edit a writable skill or fork a read-only source.

capabilities.label: Versions
capabilities.description: inspect revisions, source updates, diffs, and selected releases.

capabilities.label: Policy
capabilities.description: apply agent enablement and skill usage policy independently from installation.

capabilities.label: Testing
capabilities.description: run a bounded Studio test and inspect its result and interactions.

features.title: Team packages and installation
features.description: Catalog preview/install via CLI/API; catalog UI availability called out.

capabilities.label: Discovery
capabilities.description: list available team catalog entries and inspect package contents.

capabilities.label: Preview
capabilities.description: inspect proposed resources and installation options before mutation.

capabilities.label: Install
capabilities.description: install into the intended company and inspect resulting agents and resources.

capabilities.label: Configuration
capabilities.description: supply required adapters/accounts and verify installed agents can work.

features.title: Projects and repositories
features.description: Project lifecycle, task context, repository configuration, and defaults.

capabilities.label: Lifecycle
capabilities.description: create, name, organize, and archive projects.

capabilities.label: Task context
capabilities.description: inspect project tasks and create work in the selected project.

capabilities.label: Repositories
capabilities.description: configure repository/workspace sources and verify usable checkouts.

capabilities.label: Defaults
capabilities.description: maintain project instructions, environment, goal, and budget context where offered.

features.title: Goals and work alignment
features.description: Goal hierarchy, ownership, status, and project/task context.

capabilities.label: Hierarchy
capabilities.description: create and inspect goal level, parent, owner, and status.

capabilities.label: Alignment
capabilities.description: associate work with a valid goal in the same company.

capabilities.label: Navigation
capabilities.description: follow goal/project/task context to understand why work exists.

features.title: Workspaces, services, and files
features.description: Provisioning, task bindings, services/logs, Git/files, and closure.

capabilities.label: Binding
capabilities.description: identify the workspace actually bound to a task/run.

capabilities.label: Provisioning
capabilities.description: observe readiness and failures instead of inferring readiness from a created record.

capabilities.label: Services
capabilities.description: start/stop supported services and inspect logs and exposed endpoints.

capabilities.label: Files git
capabilities.description: inspect workspace files and repository state used for the deliverable.

capabilities.label: Closure
capabilities.description: close/reopen or reconcile through permitted controls without losing work.

features.title: Execution environments
features.description: Local, SSH, sandbox providers, target probes, and custom images.

capabilities.label: Configuration
capabilities.description: inspect local environments and configure available SSH/sandbox targets.

capabilities.label: Capabilities
capabilities.description: select only drivers/providers that advertise the required execution capability.

capabilities.label: Probe
capabilities.description: test reachability and runtime prerequisites in the actual target.

capabilities.label: Assignment
capabilities.description: bind the intended agent/project/workspace to its execution target.

capabilities.label: Images
capabilities.description: inspect supported sandbox custom-image preparation and terminal workflows.

features.title: Recovery
features.description: Stopped work, workspace repair, bounded continuation, and reconnect.

capabilities.label: Diagnosis
capabilities.description: a task/run exposes the recorded cause, evidence, owner, attempt progress, and next action without requiring a raw-log interpretation.

capabilities.label: Bounded continuation
capabilities.description: supported interrupted work continues with preserved conversation context and bounded attempts, without blindly replaying tools.

capabilities.label: Source action
capabilities.description: source-scoped recovery actions remain attached to the task; independent repair work may have its own issue and return owner.

capabilities.label: Exhaustion
capabilities.description: exhausted or overdue recovery exposes the current gate and permitted operator action; it does not claim an automatic path is still live.

capabilities.label: Workspace
capabilities.description: workspace divergence/export failures show the applicable repair, reconcile, or isolated reissue action with evidence and authority checks.

capabilities.label: Unknown outcome
capabilities.description: uncertain external side effects require inspection and an explicit decision, not automatic replay.

capabilities.label: User continuation
capabilities.description: saved user messages after a stop are reconsidered once cleanup proves the old execution is stopped; duplicate wakes are avoided.

capabilities.label: Reconnect
capabilities.description: browser stream recovery refreshes persisted state without claiming the agent itself restarted or that a failed run succeeded.

features.title: Connection setup
features.description: Catalog, MCP links, task requests, authentication, and setup resumption.

capabilities.label: Catalog
capabilities.description: find a provider, inspect its available methods, and open setup; unavailable methods explain their prerequisite rather than silently switching.

capabilities.label: Identity and access
capabilities.description: select personal/shared identity and eligible agents; an empty explicit selection and company-wide access must not be confused.

capabilities.label: Credentials
capabilities.description: provider sign-in, key, or generic MCP URL follows its supported setup method; credentials are not retained in browser draft storage.

capabilities.label: Handoff
capabilities.description: provider popup/full-page callback returns to the correct setup host with the original task intent and identity choice intact.

capabilities.label: Draft recovery
capabilities.description: cancel, Back, Save & exit, reload, Finish setup, and reconnect preserve the exact draft rather than creating duplicate connections.

capabilities.label: Task request
capabilities.description: only the addressed person resolves the requested connection; usable access releases the pending task request through normal continuation.

capabilities.label: Channel setup
capabilities.description: provider endpoint, represented agent, linked sender, and communication instructions are configured before an external message is used.

capabilities.label: Failure
capabilities.description: denied login, unreachable/private URL, expired credentials, and permission errors leave an actionable state rather than a false success.

features.title: App access and action permissions
features.description: Agent grants, off/ask/allowed actions, discovery, tests, and revocation.

capabilities.label: Agent access
capabilities.description: grant the connection to all or selected eligible agents.

capabilities.label: Action policy
capabilities.description: set off/ask/allowed independently for available actions.

capabilities.label: Catalog change
capabilities.description: review newly discovered/quarantined actions before enabling them.

capabilities.label: Test action
capabilities.description: choose an actor and inputs and inspect a real action result.

capabilities.label: Account maintenance
capabilities.description: inspect accounts, reconnect/revoke, and review connection activity.

features.title: External chat and email
features.description: Provider-specific identity, threads, files, delivery, and endpoint upkeep.

capabilities.label: Providers
capabilities.description: configure the available Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, GitHub, AgentMail, and experimental iMessage Photon paths; availability still depends on gates and provider support.

capabilities.label: Identity
capabilities.description: link the external sender to the intended authorized Paperclip identity.

capabilities.label: Conversation
capabilities.description: route inbound messages to the selected agent and send replies to the correct thread.

capabilities.label: Attachments
capabilities.description: transfer supported files with inspectable delivery and failure states.

capabilities.label: Lifecycle
capabilities.description: inspect endpoint activity, repair auth, and disable delivery when required.

features.title: Tool gateways and access profiles
features.description: Tool exposure, client configuration, tokens, profiles, and activity.

capabilities.label: Gateway
capabilities.description: create/edit an endpoint backed by a tool access profile.

capabilities.label: Profiles
capabilities.description: define reusable tool access configuration and inspect draft/detail state.

capabilities.label: Client connect
capabilities.description: copy the intended endpoint/configuration to an authorized test client.

capabilities.label: Tokens
capabilities.description: create/revoke client credentials and verify their scope.

capabilities.label: Activity
capabilities.description: inspect tool discovery/calls and explicit errors.

features.title: Secrets and proposals

capabilities.label: Company secrets
capabilities.description: create/update secret references and control their bindings.

capabilities.label: User secrets
capabilities.description: define required user credentials and set a value for the current user.

capabilities.label: Proposals
capabilities.description: review proposed changes with the appropriate authority.

capabilities.label: Vault import
capabilities.description: import eligible external-vault references through the offered flow.

capabilities.label: Runtime delivery
capabilities.description: deliver only the secret references authorized for the run/actor.

features.title: Plugins

capabilities.label: Installation
capabilities.description: install a trusted test package or local development plugin through supported controls.

capabilities.label: Configuration
capabilities.description: save validated configuration and inspect activation/failure state.

capabilities.label: Contributions
capabilities.description: open plugin routes, settings, tools, and contributed resource tabs.

capabilities.label: Lifecycle
capabilities.description: disable/remove or reload a disposable plugin and observe cleanup.

features.title: Routines, schedules, and triggers

capabilities.label: Definition
capabilities.description: save the request, agent, project, variables, and execution context.

capabilities.label: Triggers
capabilities.description: configure supported schedules/webhooks or other offered triggers.

capabilities.label: Run now

capabilities.label: History

capabilities.label: Management

capabilities.label: Stages
capabilities.description: configure stage order, behavior, and automation assignees.

capabilities.label: Items

capabilities.label: Review
capabilities.description: act on the pipeline review queue and inspect the resulting transition.

capabilities.label: Learnings
capabilities.description: inspect the separate learning view and its source context.

features.title: Cases

capabilities.label: Browse
capabilities.description: search, filter, sort, group, and navigate case records.

capabilities.label: Structure
capabilities.description: inspect fields and parent/child relationships without losing matching descendants.

capabilities.label: History
capabilities.description: inspect revisions and activity for a record.

capabilities.label: Task links
capabilities.description: follow work associated with a case in both directions.

features.title: Status cards

capabilities.label: Authoring
capabilities.description: create a card and configure its prompt, refresh behavior, and summarizer.

capabilities.label: Generation
capabilities.description: observe compilation/refresh tasks and their successful or failed output.

capabilities.label: Inspection
capabilities.description: read the summary, watched work, history, and available query debugging.

capabilities.label: Archive
capabilities.description: archive and restore without confusing a stale summary with a current result.

capabilities.label: Budgets

capabilities.label: Incidents
capabilities.description: distinguish warnings, hard stops, and manual pauses.

capabilities.label: Resolution
capabilities.description: raise or resolve a budget incident through authorized controls and verify resumption.

capabilities.label: Overview
capabilities.description: inspect the company dashboard and live-work summary.

capabilities.label: Activity
capabilities.description: filter and page through recorded actor/resource events.

capabilities.label: Runs
capabilities.description: find executions and follow their task/agent context.

capabilities.label: Routine audit
capabilities.description: inspect routine execution activity separately from its definition.

capabilities.label: Timeline
capabilities.description: use the available timeline view to understand work over time.

capabilities.label: Preferences

capabilities.label: Profile
capabilities.description: edit personal identity and inspect public profile links.

capabilities.label: Announcements
capabilities.description: inspect and dismiss an announcement with its intended instance-wide user scope.

capabilities.label: Fallbacks

capabilities.label: Server service

capabilities.label: Configuration

capabilities.label: Diagnostics

capabilities.label: Domain commands

capabilities.label: Outputs

capabilities.label: Run controls

capabilities.label: Worktree instances
